response.sql: WITH matched_records AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) as risk_margin_count FROM orders o INNER JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), aggregates AS (SELECT SUM(risk_margin_count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_timespans FROM matched_records) SELECT mr.timespan, mr.risk_margin_count, mr.risk_margin_count * 1.0 / ag.total_count as share, (mr.risk_margin_count * 1.0 / ag.total_count) - (1.0 / ag.num_timespans) as distance_from_avg FROM matched_records mr, aggregates ag ORDER BY mr.timespan

assumptions.assumption: "Time in force" refers to orders.timespan (TimeSpan_enum: IOC, GTC, GTD, FOK), and the risk/margin count is the cardinality of riskandmargin records matched to orders with that timespan

"Average share across time-in-force values" is the theoretical mean (1.0 / count of distinct timespan values), and distance is the signed difference (share - avg_share), preserving full decimal precision without rounding
